points.description: The compiler provides/creates a default constructor when no constructor is defined/provided for the class by the programmer.
points.partial_credit: Half or more if vague (e.g. says the compiler creates it automatically but does not say it is only when the class has no constructor).

points.description: If a constructor is defined for the class (any user-defined constructor), the compiler does not create a default constructor.

rubric.notes: Full marks for stating that the compiler supplies a default constructor when the class has no constructor of its own, in any wording. The second point is a smaller extra: a class that defines any constructor gets no default one. Answers that only describe what a constructor is, or give wrong conditions, earn little or nothing.
